Vision and objectives

Vision To empower HDB residents to reduce household food waste through an accessible community fridge and a user-friendly digital platform that makes sharing, tracking and collecting surplus food simple, convenient and rewarding
Objectives
1. Reduce Household Food Waste Encourage residents to contribute surplus fresh ingredients instead of throwing  away unused food, extending the usefulness of edible ingredients.
2. Improve Access to Affordable Food Allow residents, especially lower-income households, to access fresh ingredients at no cost, helping reduce their grocery expenses
3. Strengthen Neighbourhood Connections Create a sharing culture among HDB residents by encouraging neighbours to help one another through food sharing and community participation.

4. Promote Smart Food Management Through Technology Use a simple mobile application to track food contributions, collections and expiry dates, ensuring better inventory management and reducing food spoilage
5. Encourage Sustainable Living Promote environmentally responsible habits and contribute towards a greener, more sustainable HDB neighbourhood.

6. Increase Food Visibility and Reduce Food Wastage  Provide residents with daily updates on newly donated food items, allowing them to see what ingredients are available in the community fridge or pantry and encourage them to use them by providing recipes
